question: Should `channelData.openclawProgressKind = "tool-progress"` and `isToolProgressPayload` become a permanent public plugin-SDK contract for generic transient tool progress?
rationale: The native-block bypass has a mechanical fix, but exporting a new plugin API is a compatibility decision that cannot safely be inferred from the implementation alone.

options.title: Approve generic progress intent
options.body: Keep the marker and predicate, fix Slack to consume them before every render branch, and add focused compatibility coverage.

options.title: Keep progress internal
options.body: Remove the public exports and carry progress intent through an internal or owner-local typed boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve generic progress intent
recommendation.body: Keep the marker and predicate, fix Slack to consume them before every render branch, and add focused compatibility coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the current Slack delivery architecture and is the strongest available owner for deciding how its progress intent should cross the plugin boundary.
